notes.title: Reinforced Hearts Demo final version
notes.content:
[b]We are excited to announce that the Reinforced Hearts Demo has been updated to the latest available version, marking the beginning of the journey towards Early Access![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3369620/Reinforced_Hearts_Demo/

This update includes important points reported by testers, as well as improvements in various aspects:

[list] [*] New character selection menu

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45281474/b35d906966d8ca199ed8e5c4d624f3e94f94f0f0.png[/img] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45281474/f3fe5f9e58ac5ba7c06f9201db4022820d2c292b.png[/img] 
[*] New map menu including cardinal directions, coordinate grid, and points of interest for all NPCs in the area, as well as the ability to click and spawn the guide to any point on the map

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45281474/1393a79b69f2c5405709a8e0d7948b6f4e8df841.png[/img] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45281474/f3fe5f9e58ac5ba7c06f9201db4022820d2c292b.png[/img]
[*] 100% controller support both in-game and in menus

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45281474/25f9407e0953d18e3c403df7e79500c2509bd56e.png[/img]
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45281474/f3fe5f9e58ac5ba7c06f9201db4022820d2c292b.png[/img] 
[*] New initial village map, Forest Camp, now larger and more visually appealing

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45281474/a6dce0044e84a6c86370c739dde374ab29c463f8.png[/img] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45281474/ffd0628b4a9b4a808f946cf1eaf2528f483c7232.png[/img]
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45281474/7c8fd2b686aa7b95484ac0728b87ba3fd41d70c3.png[/img]
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45281474/f3fe5f9e58ac5ba7c06f9201db4022820d2c292b.png[/img] 
[*] Renovated training room, no longer reduces real health, and added a check when executing a command from the selected class list. Also, a training weapon is now provided for combat even if you don't have a real weapon

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45281474/3a8ef06cd0e7c5936469bdd092306abc1265d6e1.png[/img] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45281474/f3fe5f9e58ac5ba7c06f9201db4022820d2c292b.png[/img] [/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3369620/Reinforced_Hearts_Demo/

notes.title: Map System Updated
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3369620/Reinforced_Hearts_Demo/]Reinforced Hearts Demo[/url]

[h1]Patch Notes 1.0.5[/h1]
 
 [h2]-Map improved, now the Map have a better visibility and include a guide System to no get lost on the Town[/h2]

     [h3]Just press [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45281474/714445cffa5bd364e56aa142a48f9a2fd3e56f46.png[/img] and click over any Point of Interest of the Map, after reach your objective just press Clear Follow.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45281474/ab513fea0cc71d7431a0923d3cadffacca8ee1e6.png[/img]
